legacy_location_fields.interpretation: The v0.2.18 local finding locations do not expose native_font_enabled. Existing original-program captures contain document-level diagnostics, not per-run enabled state; therefore the 12 removals cannot be attributed to run enabled=false from these artifacts.

limits: Counts describe local diagnostic-scope changes across 17 same-hash private inputs; they are not an accuracy estimate.
Original captures establish whether a mapped diagnostic family appeared, not its source run or effective enabled flag.
No private case identifiers, document paths, text excerpts, or per-document source hashes are included.
